cases.title: Initiate Drag Event on Product Item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true') successfully initiates a drag event and captures the correct product title and price using the respective data-testid attributes.

cases.title: Drop Product Into Cart and Update Display
cases.description: Verify that dropping a product item into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') updates the cart display: quantity in .box1, product title in .box2, and unit price in .box3, supporting both different and repeated products.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates the sum of all prices for products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displays it in the <div id='allMoney'> element.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover the core requirements adequately, and present no blockers preventing execution or testing.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Testable behavior includes initiating a drag event on 'li' elements with draggable="true" and capturing title/price via data-testid attributes ('product-item-X', 'product-title-X', 'product-price-X'). Normal path: dragging a valid product item populates the drag data transfer. Abnormal path: attempting to drag a non-draggable element. Boundaries: items with valid vs. missing data-testid attributes. Ambiguity: exact data transfer format (JSON vs. plain text) is not specified. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Testable behavior includes dropping product items into the drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area") and updating cart elements (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, .box3 for unit price). Normal path: dropping single and multiple products (both unique and repeated). Abnormal path: dropping invalid elements outside the drop target. Boundaries: adding the first item vs. subsequent identical/different items. Ambiguity: how repeated products are grouped or listed in .box2/.box3 is not fully detailed. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Testable behavior includes calculating the total price of all cart items and displaying it in <div id="allMoney"> formatted to two decimal places with a currency symbol. Normal path: cart with one or multiple items computes correct sum. Abnormal path: empty cart handling. Boundaries: zero total, single-item total, multi-item total with rounding. Ambiguity: expected currency symbol if multiple currencies are theoretically supported.
